title: Diorama Journey

description.en: Miniature 3D storytelling with narration, chapter clips and slides
description.zh: 以微型 3D 场景讲故事，输出配音视频、章节切片和演示文稿

subject: Profile landscape emoji; a skill for connected miniature 3D worlds

source.description: Miniature 3D storytelling with narration, chapter clips and slides

goal.en: Turn an outline, report, lesson or process into a narrated journey through connected miniature 3D worlds. One recurring element links the chapters; the same composition produces a film, exact chapter clips, presentations, speaker notes and an archived production.
goal.zh: 将大纲、报告、课程或流程组织成穿越微型 3D 世界的配音故事。以同一个元素串联各章，从同一套画面导出成片、章节切片、演示文稿、演讲备注和制作归档。

role.en: Frame timeline, shared composition, player and H.264 video rendering
role.zh: 逐帧时间轴、共享画面、播放器和 H.264 视频渲染

role.en: Original geometric scenes, lighting and continuous camera movement
role.zh: 原创几何场景、灯光和连续镜头运动

role.en: Standalone review website and typed source
role.zh: 独立审片网站与类型检查

role.en: Audio mastering, exact chapter cuts and isolated media scripts
role.zh: 音频处理、精确章节切片和独立媒体脚本环境

role.en: Cached Microsoft speech and original synthesized music
role.zh: 可缓存的微软语音与原创合成音乐

role.en: PPTX, ODP and PDF from clean keyframes, with native presentation notes
role.zh: 由干净关键帧导出 PPTX、ODP 和 PDF，并保留原生演讲备注
